Landmark permits handled.

Work on a landmarked facade can’t start with a hammer — it starts with paperwork. Landmark and permit requirements are handled as part of the job, so the restoration is approved before the scaffold goes up.

LPC applications

Landmarks Preservation Commission filings for work on designated buildings and historic-district facades.

DOB permits & filings

NYC Department of Buildings permits coordinated alongside the restoration work itself.

Licensed & insured

Restoration and masonry work carried out licensed and insured, across all four boroughs served.
